# 1,000.00 USD of income paid into A at −500.00, the split stating its own guid
# as the cost basis it repays.
#
# What the 500.00 it brings in cost is worked out from the cost basis it
# repays, which is itself, so nothing prices it. It is refused as a guid that
# matches no cost basis is, rather than working its own cost out from its own
# cost for ever.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
